members.name: macd_histogram_divergence_v1
members.thesis: MACD histogram divergence (price makes new low but MACD histogram doesn't) signals momentum exhaustion before price reverses. Unlike RSI divergence, MACD histogram captures the rate of change of momentum, making it a leading indicator. The inefficiency exists because MACD divergence requires real-ti
filters: no trades first 30 min or last 30 min
weaknesses: MACD on 1-min bars with 12/26/9 parameters is extremely lagging — by the time divergence confirms and histogram crosses zero, the reversal may be 70%+ done.
Profit factor of 1.08 is barely above breakeven. Slippage model errors would make this negative.
Divergence detection is inherently ambiguous — different pivot definitions produce different signals. Hard to validate out-of-sample.
members.prior_art: MACD histogram divergence. Alexander Elder's 'Trading for a Living'. Textbook setup.

members.name: macd_signal_momentum_v1
members.thesis: MACD(12,26,9) on 1-min bars generates a momentum signal when the MACD line crosses the signal line, but the key edge comes from the MACD histogram acceleration: when the histogram is not only positive but INCREASING (histogram[t] > histogram[t-1] > histogram[t-2]), momentum is accelerating and the t
members.exit_target: 0.4% from entry OR MACD histogram deceleration (hist_accel < 0 for longs)
members.exit_stop: 0.25% from entry OR MACD line crosses below signal line
filters: no entries before 09:30 (MACD needs warmup) or after 14:45
VWAP alignment required (long above VWAP, short below)
weaknesses: MACD(12,26,9) was designed for daily bars — on 1-min bars, the lookbacks are very short (26 min) and noisy
Histogram acceleration can be caused by a single large bar, creating false acceleration signals
The 3-bar acceleration requirement means entry is delayed — by the time signal fires, much of the move may be done

members.name: macd_trend_continuation_v71
members.thesis: Momentum breeds momentum in intraday equities. When the MACD line crosses the signal line in the direction of the primary trend, it flags an acceleration of institutional buying/selling. Exists due to autocorrelated order flow.
entry_long: close > ema_50 AND CROSSOVER(macd_line, macd_signal) AND macd_line < 0
entry_short: close < ema_50 AND CROSSUNDER(macd_line, macd_signal) AND macd_line > 0
weaknesses: Late entry compared to pure price action breakouts
Susceptible to sudden mean-reverting algorithmic spikes
